title: NEB Class 11 Mock Exam 03 — Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Mathematics

questions.prompt: Which organelle contains its own DNA and ribosomes, supporting the endosymbiotic theory?
questions.explanation: Mitochondria (and plastids) carry their own circular DNA and 70S ribosomes, evidence of prokaryotic ancestry.

questions.prompt: The significance of meiosis in sexually reproducing organisms is that it produces:
questions.explanation: One meiotic division cycle yields four haploid daughter cells with new gene combinations.

questions.prompt: Dryopteris, the fern commonly studied for its vascular tissue and sori, is an example of:
questions.explanation: Ferns are seedless vascular plants — pteridophytes reproducing by spores in sori.

questions.prompt: Deuteromycetes are popularly called imperfect fungi because they:
questions.explanation: 'Imperfect' refers only to the absence of an observed sexual reproductive phase.

questions.prompt: Yeast (Saccharomyces), an ascomycete, is economically important because it is used in:
questions.explanation: Yeast ferments sugars into ethanol and CO₂, driving baking and brewing industries.

questions.prompt: In the reaction 2H₂ + O₂ → 2H₂O, if 4 mol H₂ react with 3 mol O₂, the limiting reactant is:
questions.explanation: 4 mol H₂ requires exactly 2 mol O₂, and 3 mol O₂ is available; hydrogen is therefore consumed first and limits the water formed to 4 mol.

questions.prompt: The oxidation number of sulphur in H₂SO₄ is:
For an electron with principal quantum number n = 3, the allowed values of l are:
questions.explanation: l runs from 0 to n − 1, so n = 3 allows l = 0 (s), 1 (p) and 2 (d).

questions.prompt: The chemical bond formed by complete transfer of electrons from sodium to chlorine in NaCl is:
questions.explanation: Na loses one electron and Cl gains it; electrostatic attraction between Na⁺ and Cl⁻ forms the ionic bond.

questions.prompt: By Graham's law of diffusion, the ratio of rates of diffusion of CH₄ (M = 16) and O₂ (M = 32) under identical conditions is approximately:
questions.explanation: r(CH₄)/r(O₂) = √(32/16) = √2 ≈ 1.41 : 1; lighter methane diffuses faster.

questions.prompt: The derivative of f(x) = x³ with respect to x is:
questions.explanation: Power rule: d/dx xⁿ = n xⁿ⁻¹ gives 3x².

questions.prompt: ∫ 2x dx equals:
questions.explanation: ∫xⁿ dx = xⁿ⁺¹/(n+1) + C so ∫2x dx = 2·x²/2 + C = x² + C.

questions.prompt: A function satisfying f(−x) = f(x) for every x in its domain is called:
questions.explanation: Even functions like x² or cos x are symmetric about the y-axis; odd ones satisfy f(−x) = −f(x).

questions.prompt: The stationary points of f(x) = x³ − 3x² occur where f′(x) = 0, i.e. at:
questions.explanation: f′ = 3x² − 6x = 3x(x − 2) vanishes at x = 0 and x = 2.

questions.prompt: The standard limit lim(x→0) sin x / x equals:
questions.explanation: This foundational trigonometric limit equals 1 when x is measured in radians.

questions.prompt: Neglecting air resistance, the horizontal range of a projectile launched with fixed speed is maximum at a projection angle of:
questions.explanation: R = u² sin 2θ/g peaks when 2θ = 90°, i.e. θ = 45°.

questions.prompt: The work done by the centripetal force on a body completing one full circle is:
questions.explanation: Centripetal force stays perpendicular to displacement at every instant, so W = ∫F·ds = 0.

questions.prompt: The orbital velocity of a satellite orbiting just above the Earth's surface is approximately:
questions.explanation: v_o = √(gR) ≈ 7.9 km/s near the surface; escape velocity is √2 times this.

questions.prompt: Young's modulus, the ratio of tensile stress to longitudinal strain, is expressed in SI units of:
questions.explanation: Stress (N/m²) divided by dimensionless strain leaves N/m², the pascal.

questions.prompt: According to the Stefan–Boltzmann law, the total energy radiated per second by a black body is proportional to:
questions.explanation: E = σAT⁴: radiated power grows with the fourth power of absolute temperature.
